name_en: Igamochi — steamed rice-flour dumplings crowned with colored sticky rice
summary_ja: 米粉の皮で小豆あんを包み、ピンクや緑に染めたもち米の粒を乗せて蒸す呉の菓子。栗のいがに似ることが名の由来のひとつとされ、亀山神社の秋祭りの屋台で今も蒸したてが売られている。
summary_en: Sweet azuki paste is wrapped in a rice-flour dough and topped with sticky rice grains dyed pink or green, then steamed—a confection from Kure. One story behind the name likens the studded top to a chestnut bur, and it is still sold hot off the steamer at festival stalls around Kameyama Shrine's autumn rites.
